message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Additionally, there are 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned when you finish a round by discarding all your cards. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Turn Sequence** | 1. **Draw** – If you cannot play a card, draw one from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, keep it and end your turn.
2. **Play** – Place a card from your hand onto the discard pile if it matches the top card in color, number, or symbol. You may also play a Wild or Wild Draw Four at any time.
3. **End Turn** – After playing, discard any remaining cards you wish to play. Then pass the turn to the next player (clockwise unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player chooses the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise, you risk being challenged.) | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have only one card left, you must say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player notices before the next turn starts, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points based on the cards remaining in opponents’ hands: number cards = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20 points, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 points. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. The first player to reach the target score (usually 500) wins the game. | **Optional Variations** | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **Stacking** | Players may stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards on top of each other, forcing the next player to draw the cumulative total unless they can counter with the same card type. | | **No Wild Draw Four Challenge** | Some groups allow Wild Draw Four to be played freely without the challenge rule. | | **Custom Decks** | Use themed decks (e.g., Uno Attack) or add extra cards for house rules. | **Key Tips** 1. Keep track of the current color and number to anticipate opponents’ moves. 2. Use action cards strategically to block opponents or force them to draw. 3. Remember the “UNO” rule—failure to call it can cost you two cards. Enjoy playing Uno!
